period_note: Solo (bank-only) Balance Sheet and Profit and Loss Account from National Bank's 2nd-Quarter 2024 unaudited financial statements; plain 'Balance Sheet (Un-audited)'/'Profit and Loss Account (Un-audited)' sections used (Solo+OBU basis). Comparative column (31 Dec 2023) reproduces the known FY2023 equity of 23189.24m exactly. Equity continued falling: 15473.99m (Mar 2024) to 12390.74m (Jun 2024), still positive. Income-statement items are CUMULATIVE from 1 January 2024 (first of four P&L columns). This filing's OCR text is noisier than most (extraneous punctuation throughout); 'Investment income' (H1-2024, ~9746.38m) and 'Total operating expenses' (H1-2024, printed with an apparent duplicated leading digit as '77,784,646,618') carry more OCR uncertainty than other fields in this record, so operating_profit and profit_after_tax are anchored instead to the doubly-confirmed figure: 'Profit before taxes' and 'Net Profit after taxation' both print an identical parenthesized -10,797,737,642m, which independently confirms zero provision and zero tax this half-year; operating_profit and profit_after_tax are both set to this anchor value rather than the noisier component sum. EPS of -3.38 is as printed but differs slightly (~1%) from EPS implied by PAT/shares-outstanding (-3.35); not corrected, flagged as minor OCR-range uncertainty. Source PDF was image-only; text obtained via OCR (tesseract, 300dpi).
